addressDifference.sampleMethod: Three deterministic SHA-ranked examples per conflict class, then SHA-ranked fill to 50.

centroid.combinedHighRiskDefinition: like-for-like centroid shift >250 ft AND historical/current geometry area difference >10% AND (parcel ID differs OR conservative address conflict)
centroid.interpretation: The 3,889 Packet 7 live stored-coordinate flags primarily measure a V1 coordinate-method/lineage difference. Recomputing historical V1 and current V2 geometry centroids consistently leaves two parcels over 250 feet.

evidence.boundary: Local sealed/read-only evidence only; two attempted read-only production centroid aggregate queries timed out and produced no evidence or mutation.

sources.name: parcels_enriched_canon_v1.csv
sources.role: historical V1 parcel lineage and geometry

principles: possible_replacement never asserts a legal successor or redirects automatically.

missingAddress.doctrine: Prefer current V2 address; otherwise retain current SanGIS street as a number-unavailable locator. Use a positive-number V1 address only as explicitly historical Regrid fallback with provenance. Never present a leading-zero historical address as a current situs.

nextRecommendation: Base Zoning V2 may proceed in parallel only as isolated current-source work keyed to canonical V2 APNs. Identity-dependent shadow serving or cutover remains blocked by 10,172 unresolved cases and 18 genuine potential regressions.

searchBehavior.historicalApnWithSuccessorEvidence: Show a provenance-labelled possible relationship; do not automatically redirect.
searchBehavior.missingCurrentSitus: Search/display current street with number unavailable; use one of 14 validated historical addresses only with fallback label and provenance.
searchBehavior.quarantinedValidIdentity: Allow an identity-only result with geometry unavailable and quarantine reason.
searchBehavior.unresolvedIdentity: Do not silently redirect or promote.
